additional_info.subject: Status Update - Chargers added to Tenant YHI
additional_info.body:
The reported chargers have now been successfully assigned to the YHI tenant.
While these chargers were already onboarded within the SCB system, the requester encountered visibility issues. This was due to the specific role configurations for external users within SCB, which restrict their view to only those chargers explicitly tagged with their associated tenant (in this instance, YHI).
With the correct tenant tagging now applied to the chargers, external users affiliated with Tenant YHI should be able to view them as intended.
To ensure complete resolution, I recommend verifying with the requester that the chargers are now visible. Once this confirmation is received, this ticket can be closed.
